scope: Conversion-first exploratory pass; no first-principles interaction or independent validation claimed
distance_policy: Adopt catalog_distance_mpc as the physical path R in the declared Euclidean benchmark, per the user's fixed published-distance fiction. Do not re-infer R from brightness or apply the historical D_L=R(1+z) relation.
redshift_policy: Use catalog observed_cmb_z, retaining its published reference-frame transformation as an observational convention. No expansion model, cosmological peculiar-velocity inference, or archived FLRW prediction is used. An additive residual in c*z represents unresolved motion/endpoints/calibration, not their physical derivation.
model: z=expm1(alpha_per_mpc*R); constant alpha>=0; fixed photon speed and material clock standards in the illustrative baseline
controls: fitted linear small-optical-depth law z=alpha*R (not an expansion model)
zero conversion with no fitted source motion (diagnostic only)
fitting: Use only recovered train rows to minimize squared c*z residuals, equivalent to a Gaussian likelihood with common fixed 300 km/s residual scale. No intercept, no per-galaxy coefficients, no distance fitting. Parameter bracket c*alpha in [0,150] km/s/Mpc; report boundary behavior. The c*alpha units are a conversion parameter, not an assumed Hubble constant.
split: Preserve the published recovered train/validation/test labels and sky tiles; all three are previously exposed exploratory partitions, not fresh holdouts.
uncertainty: Primary adopted distances are fixed facts. Retain their published errors as provenance only. Training sky-tile bootstrap 500 resamples, seed 2026090901; paired test-tile bootstrap 1000 resamples, seed 2026090902. Report percentile intervals descriptively, with shared calibration/correlated motion limitations. Nominal 95% residual coverage uses 1.96*300 km/s and omits fitted parameter uncertainty.
no_posthoc_success_threshold: Report absolute residuals and comparator differences; do not call a low-z distance trend proof of companion production or a successful unified theory.
mechanism_diagnostics: Energy partition, Poisson width, fixed-speed event timing, capture probability and finite-retention calculations are stipulated forward models. All scenario values must be labeled illustrative rather than measured.
validation_gap: No new raw spectra, transient light curves, joint luminosity histories or companion detections are supplied by this fit. Microscopic conversion, angular transfer, storage, field response and fresh validation remain open.
